title: ArcBio Continuous DNA Workflow - Pre-PCR Instrument: DNA-PRE-PCR-2 Adapter Ligation
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Mix reagent 12 at 4°C
steps.instruction: Combine reagent 12 with all samples while they are held at 4 °C on the Temperature Module.

steps.title: Pause for off‑deck thermocycler
steps.instruction: Stop the OT‑2 run and remove the plate for the off‑deck thermocycler step.

steps.title: Mix adapters at 4°C
steps.instruction: Add adapters to the samples and mix while the plate remains on the Temperature Module at 4 °C.

steps.title: Mix enzyme mix at 4°C
steps.instruction: Add the enzyme mix to the samples and mix while the plate is on the Temperature Module at 4 °C.

steps.title: Proceed to thermocycler steps
steps.instruction: Return the plate to the off‑deck thermocycler and continue with the subsequent thermocycling program.
